basis: mobile-ui-ux-designer interaction contract; existing CISME layout/tokens

surfaces.cold: two-column card structure skeleton, exited immediately by valid data/empty/error
surfaces.refresh: retain same-owner cards and images; stable hidden refresh indicator; 401/403 clears projection
surfaces.images: current resource/version key; load then one opacity arrival; image-only retry; ignore late hidden/old-account callbacks

surfaces.refresh: retain same-owner core snapshot; independent avatar, support, membership projections remain truthful

surfaces.cold: conservative static placeholders with common bone color
surfaces.refresh: keep existing guarded progressive read strategy; no invented zero balances, member names or counts

surfaces.cold: existing context and list geometry, shared bone/sweep
surfaces.refresh: keep authorized context; filter changes own loading; no perpetual count skeleton after failure
surfaces.access: aftersale 401/403 clears private state and routes to existing usable workspace; transient failure keeps genuine retry, no permission grant

surfaces.cold: existing local read feedback; short operations keep local spinner
surfaces.refresh: preserve existing context/geometry while guarded reads revalidate; visual snapshots never authorize price, inventory or financial writes

surfaces.upload: per-file measured bytes/SDK progress only; PUT remains indeterminate without byte events; chunk progress uses actual acknowledged bytes
surfaces.completion: upload/assembly -> server confirmation -> ready; only real server success unlocks sending/publishing
surfaces.interruptions: existing page/account/environment/draft/attempt fences and command identifiers preserved; cleanup listener on finish/cancel

surfaces.progress: existing confirmed rows/counts only; no time-generated percent; retry original batch and immutable results
surfaces.financialFlows: payment/refund/receipt status follows server receipts and reconciliation; no simulated completion animation

nativePreview.scope: official full native preview compilation; scoped motion sampling and physical device acceptance are distinct
